name: minikube
description: Minikube provisions and manages local Kubernetes clusters optimized for development workflows

subcommands.name: start
subcommands.description: Starts a local Kubernetes cluster

options.name: --addons
options.description: Enable addons. see `minikube addons list` for a list of valid addon names

options.name: --apiserver-ips
options.description: A set of apiserver IP Addresses which are used in the generated certificate for kubernetes

options.name: --apiserver-name
options.description: The authoritative apiserver hostname for apiserver certificates and connectivity

options.name: --apiserver-names
options.description: A set of apiserver names which are used in the generated certificate for kubernetes

options.name: --apiserver-port
options.description: The apiserver listening port

options.name: --auto-update-drivers
options.description: If set, automatically updates drivers to the latest version

options.name: --base-image
options.description: The base image to use for docker/podman drivers. Intended for local development

options.name: --cache-images
options.description: If true, cache docker images for the current bootstrapper and load them into the machine

options.name: --cert-expiration
options.description: Duration until minikube certificate expiration

options.name: --cni
options.description: CNI plug-in to use

options.name: --container-runtime
options.description: The container runtime to be used

options.name: --cpus
options.description: Number of CPUs allocated to Kubernetes

options.name: --cri-socket
options.description: The cri socket path to be used

options.name: --delete-on-failure
options.description: If set, delete the current cluster if start fails and try again

options.name: --disable-driver-mounts
options.description: Disables the filesystem mounts provided by the hypervisors

options.name: --disk-size
options.description: Disk size allocated to the minikube VM

options.name: --dns-domain
options.description: The cluster dns domain name used in the Kubernetes cluster

options.name: --dns-proxy
options.description: Enable proxy for NAT DNS requests

options.name: --docker-env
options.description: Environment variables to pass to the Docker daemon. (format: key=value)

options.name: --docker-opt
options.description: Specify arbitrary flags to pass to the Docker daemon. (format: key=value)

options.name: --download-only
options.description: If true, only download and cache files for later use - don't install or start anything

options.name: --driver
options.description: Choose driver

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Dry-run mode. Validates configuration, but does not mutate system state

options.name: --embed-certs
options.description: If true, will embed the certs in kubeconfig

options.name: --extra-config
options.description: A set of key=value pairs that describe configuration that may be passed to different components

options.name: --extra-disks
options.description: Number of extra disks created and attached to the minikube VM

options.name: --feature-gates
options.description: A set of key=value pairs that describe feature gates for alpha/experimental features

options.name: --force
options.description: Force minikube to perform possibly dangerous operations

options.name: --force-systemd
options.description: If set, force the container runtime to use systemd as cgroup manager

options.name: --host-dns-resolver
options.description: Enable host resolver for NAT DNS requests

options.name: --host-only-cidr
options.description: The CIDR to be used for the minikube VM

options.name: --host-only-nic-type
options.description: NIC Type used for host only network

options.name: --hyperkit-vpnkit-sock
options.description: Location of the VPNKit socket used for networking

options.name: --hyperkit-vsock-ports
options.description: List of guest VSock ports that should be exposed as sockets on the host

options.name: --hyperv-external-adapter
options.description: External Adapter on which external switch will be created if no external switch is found

options.name: --hyperv-use-external-switch
options.description: Whether to use external switch over Default Switch if virtual switch not explicitly specified

options.name: --hyperv-virtual-switch
options.description: The hyperv virtual switch name. Defaults to first found

options.name: --image-mirror-country
options.description: Country code of the image mirror to be used

options.name: --image-repository
options.description: Alternative image repository to pull docker images from

options.name: --insecure-registry
options.description: Insecure Docker registries to pass to the Docker daemon

options.name: --install-addons
options.description: If set, install addons. Defaults to true

options.name: --interactive
options.description: Allow user prompts for more information

options.name: --iso-url
options.description: Locations to fetch the minikube ISO from

options.description: This will keep the existing kubectl context and will create a minikube context

options.description: The Kubernetes version that the minikube VM will use

options.name: --kvm-gpu
options.description: Enable experimental NVIDIA GPU support in minikube

options.name: --kvm-hidden
options.description: Hide the hypervisor signature from the guest in minikube

options.name: --kvm-network
options.description: The KVM default network name

options.name: --kvm-numa-count
options.description: Simulate numa node count in minikube, supported numa node count range is 1-8

options.name: --kvm-qemu-uri
options.description: The KVM QEMU connection URI

options.name: --listen-address
options.description: IP Address to use to expose ports

options.name: --memory
options.description: Amount of RAM to allocate to Kubernetes

options.name: --mount
options.description: This will start the mount daemon and automatically mount files into minikube

options.name: --mount-string
options.description: The argument to pass the minikube mount command on start

options.name: --namespace
options.description: The named space to activate after start

options.name: --nat-nic-type
options.description: NIC Type used for nat network

options.name: --native-ssh
options.description: Use native Golang SSH client

options.description: Kubelet network plug-in to use

options.name: --nfs-share
options.description: Local folders to share with Guest via NFS mounts

options.name: --nfs-shares-root
options.description: Where to root the NFS Shares

options.name: --no-kubernetes
options.description: If set, minikube VM/container will start without starting or configuring Kubernetes

options.name: --no-vtx-check
options.description: Disable checking for the availability of hardware virtualization before the vm is started

options.name: --nodes
options.description: The number of nodes to spin up

options.name: -n
options.description: The number of nodes to spin up

options.name: --output
options.description: Format to print stdout in

options.name: -o
options.description: Format to print stdout in

options.name: --ports
options.description: List of ports that should be exposed

options.name: --preload
options.description: If set, download tarball of preloaded images if available to improve start time

options.name: --registry-mirror
options.description: Registry mirrors to pass to the Docker daemon

options.name: --service-cluster-ip-range
options.description: The CIDR to be used for service cluster IPs

options.name: --ssh-ip-address
options.description: IP address

options.name: --ssh-key
options.description: SSH key

options.name: --ssh-port
options.description: SSH port

options.name: --ssh-user
options.description: SSH user

options.name: --trace
options.description: Send trace events

options.description: Provide VM UUID to restore MAC address

options.description: Filter to use only VM Drivers

options.name: --wait
options.description: Comma separated list of Kubernetes components to verify and wait for after starting a cluster

options.name: --wait-timeout
options.description: Max time to wait per Kubernetes or host to be healthy
